recovery_procedure: Rerun the required READ-ONLY inputs exactly once (no additional retries).
Persist all raw responses to disk FIRST, before any computation.
Recompute the run only from the persisted raw files (never from in-memory partial state).

Continue through the SAME pre-authorized guarded execution path; every internal validation, signal, budget, spread, confidence/trend, top-up, and circuit-breaker check must still pass unchanged (nothing is loosened for recovery).

Reuse the same logical scheduled run directory for the stream (morning_dca/YYYYMMDD_1030ET/, midday_dca/YYYYMMDD_1230ET/, or scheduled_runs/YYYYMMDD_1520ET/) and stamp recovery_rerun=true on the run_state.

failure_recovery_policy.recovery_limits: Recovery is a within-schedule repair only: it does not change the fire time, does not re-arm after a second failure, and never places more than the one permitted strategy order per ticker per stream.
failure_recovery_policy.escalation: If the single recovery attempt also fails, or if a safety / account / order rejection occurs, write run_state.json recording the blocking reason (recovery.blocking_reason) and escalate; do NOT retry further and do NOT downgrade to an interactive/manual path.

final_buy_budget_tier_fix.summary: Final buy budget-tier fix for the afternoon task 10ce362c. Before placing any final-buy order the run computes the budget tier from the full actionable incremental plan and the count of 3x-or-greater signals, folds prior same-day strategy allocation into daily-cap usage for safety, and blocks the overflow deterministically instead of escalating without complete artifacts.
rules: Compute the budget tier BEFORE order placement using the full actionable incremental plan (summed incremental desired amounts) and the count of 3x-or-greater signals.
Normal tier: planned spend <= $129 and 3x-or-greater signals <= 5, corrected daily cap $180.
Elevated tier: planned spend > $129 or 3x-or-greater signals 6 to 10, corrected daily cap $240.
High-volatility tier: planned spend > $213 or 3x-or-greater signals 11 to 17, corrected daily cap $300.
Stress tier: planned spend > $272 or 3x-or-greater signals > 17, corrected daily cap $360 only to the extent unused weekly rollover reserve is available.

Count same-day strategy allocation already placed in manual recovery, morning, midday, and earlier final orders as corrected-daily-cap usage for safety, while keeping the streams separate for evidence and slippage.

If planned spend exceeds the remaining corrected daily capacity, rank the remaining eligible orders by deepest drop percentage, then multiplier, then amount, place only the orders that fit the remaining cap and the per-order $15 max, and write budget_blocked.csv plus per-symbol block_reason='budget_block_corrected_daily_cap' for the rest.

If a budget-logic inconsistency is detected after any order has already been placed, recover inside the same scheduled run directory (scheduled_runs/YYYYMMDD_1520ET/), reconcile the already placed orders, apply the corrected cap logic, and finalize state rather than escalating without complete artifacts.
final_buy_budget_tier_fix.tier_selection_rule: Pick the highest tier triggered by EITHER planned spend or the count of 3x-or-greater signals. A 3x-or-greater signal is a buy candidate whose ladder multiplier is >= 3.0. Mirrors config/budgets.json budget_tiers.
